Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that the claim R-0000295, taken on 2014-11-15, for $6.00, is under review. We require the amended promotion agreement (end date) before making a decision. The claim runs past the recorded promotion end, and the shelf price stayed promotional after it; the end date on file may be incorrect. The dispute deadline is 2015-05-14, and this deadline has passed. Please provide the necessary document as soon as possible.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
Northfield Pantry Co.
